items.title: 高盛看好美國雲端巨頭成「防禦性資產」！AI資本支出2027恐見頂、獲利成長「大減速」
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Sees US Cloud Giants as "Defensive Assets"; AI Capex May Peak by 2027, Profit Growth to Slow Sharply
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）資本支出熱潮可能逐步觸頂，全球股市獲利成長動能預料將明顯放緩。不過，高盛（Goldman Sachs）最新發布的2027年全球股票策略展望指出，市場對AI投資回報及資本支出見頂的疑慮，已促使相關企業估值大幅修正，反而創造布局機會，尤其是遭市場拋售的美國大型雲端服務商，現階段估值甚至低於必需消費品類股。
高盛首席全球股票策略師Peter Oppenheimer在最新報告《Finding Value in Growth》中指出，AI相關企業近期經歷顯著估值回檔，反映投資人擔憂AI資本支出即將見頂，以及相關投資的回報速度可能放緩，但這也讓部分成長股出現更具吸引力的進場價格。
其中，美國大型雲端服務商目前預期本益比約19.7倍，不僅低於過去20年的歷史區間下緣，也低於必需消費品類股的21倍。
高盛認為，這類企業已具備相對防禦型資產的特質。
這份報告發布之際，科技股正面臨劇烈震盪。那斯達克100指數剛經歷新冠疫情以來最嚴重的單日跌幅，輝達(NVDA-US) 也因創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳離職消息衝擊而大幅下跌。
儘管如此，高盛仍看好美股後市，預估未來12個月標普500指數目標價為8700點，較目前水準有約14%上漲空間。區域市場方面，日本東證指數及亞洲市場預期上行空間最大，歐洲則相對落後，預期報酬率僅約6%。

全球股市漲勢轉向獲利支撐 估值擴張動能減弱

高盛策略團隊認為，2026年全球股市呈現三大趨勢：區域市場表現更加分散、企業獲利成為股價上漲的主要支柱，以及各市場估值普遍下修。
過去12個月，美股長期領先其他市場的格局有所改變，各地區股票總報酬率逐漸接近，但背後的驅動因素並不相同。亞洲（不含日本）及新興市場的未來12個月每股盈餘（EPS）成長，約貢獻整體報酬的70%，但本益比下修則抵銷逾半數漲幅。
企業獲利成長主要來自三大來源，包括科技產業持續成長、油價上漲帶動大宗商品生產商獲利，以及科技資本支出外溢效應，進一步推升工業等重資產、低淘汰率產業的需求。
另一方面，市場估值已不再持續擴張。標普500指數預期本益比從接近過去20年區間頂端的水準，回落至18.5倍；MSCI 全世界指數目前預期本益比為15.6倍，股價盈餘成長比（PEG）為1.1，接近過去35年平均值，雖然沒有便宜到危機水準，但相較於先前的高估值階段，風險收益比發生了變化。

AI資本支出放緩 2027年企業獲利成長恐大幅減速

高盛警告，2027年全球主要市場的企業獲利成長率可能普遍明顯下滑。
高盛預估，標普500企業獲利成長率將從36%降至11%，歐洲STOXX 600指數從18%降至7%，日本東證指數從24%降至9%，亞洲市場則從接近80%降至不到30%。
其中，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出變化，將成為影響美股獲利的重要因素。高盛估算，雲端巨頭資本支出今年對標普500每股盈餘成長的貢獻達12個百分點，高於2025年的5個百分點及2024年的2個百分點。
然而，這項貢獻預計2027年降至9個百分點，2028年更可能轉為負5個百分點。
產業方面，資訊科技業獲利成長率預計從接近90%降至45%；通訊服務業則從成長34%轉為衰退5%。能源業今年受伊朗戰爭影響，獲利預估成長99%，但之後可能收縮約10%；材料業獲利成長率則將從45%放緩至12%。
醫療保健業是唯一預期獲利成長加速的產業，但該板塊已經歷一波估值重估。
這代表過去受惠於AI資本支出熱潮的晶片、工業及能源設備等供應商，未來可能面臨成長動能減弱的壓力；相較之下，負責投入資本支出的美國雲端巨頭，卻因股價修正、估值回落，重新受到高盛青睞。

美國雲端巨頭估值低於必需消費品 成長股浮現投資價值

高盛指出，近期價值股在全球各地普遍優於成長股，價值股與成長股之間的估值差距，已從2021年高峰時超過100%，縮小至約45%至50%。
同時，目前價值因子估值已接近過去20年區間的第90百分位，從歷史相對估值來看，甚至比成長股更貴。全球科技板塊則位於過去20年估值區間的第20百分位，本益比已接近價值股。
美國大型雲端服務商的估值變化尤其值得注意，目前預期本益比約19.7倍，不僅低於過去20年歷史區間，也低於必需消費品類股的21倍。
此外，美股前五大企業相較其餘495家標普500成分股的估值溢價，也幾乎收斂，不再如2000年或2021年市場高峰時期般處於極端水準。
高盛認為，這些企業具備成為防禦型成長資產的條件，除了估值已經回落，資產負債表仍相對健全，營收來源也較為多元。以負債情況來看，已開發市場科技產業的淨負債對股東權益比僅個位數，整體市場則約為50%。

半導體、記憶體估值遭低估 高盛看好韓國DRAM及HBM需求

至於半導體、記憶體及硬體產業，高盛認為，這些具備高度景氣循環特性的成長板塊，雖然波動較大，但也蘊藏較高的潛在報酬。
高盛亞洲策略團隊估算，南韓記憶體產業目前股價，已反映市場預期2027年共識獲利下修70%的悲觀情境，但高盛認為這項預期可能過於保守，原因是相關企業已披露，DRAM及高頻寬記憶體（HBM）產品訂單已經排滿至2029年。
目前韓國記憶體類股股價淨值比僅0.7倍，以2028年預估淨值計算。高盛指出，這種估值水準在歷史上往往預示著較佳的未來報酬。
不過，高盛對亞洲市場整體仍維持中性評級，主要考量是市場集中度風險。南韓與台灣合計占MSCI新興市場指數約50%，資訊科技產業權重更超過40%；台積電(2330-TW) 、三星電子(005930KS) 及SK海力士(000660KS) 三家AI核心企業，合計占指數約30%。
在科技股高度集中的情況下，新興市場相較已開發市場的本益比折價已擴大至約50%，創下至少2010年以來最大差距。
高盛預估，亞洲（不含日本）市場以美元計算的價格報酬率可達17%，但考量年化波動率高達24.2%，經風險調整後仍維持中性配置。

油價、債券殖利率走勢成變數 高盛建議加碼美日股市

高盛2027年投資策略的另一項重要假設，是油價下跌及債券殖利率回落。
高盛大宗商品團隊預估，布蘭特原油價格將從2026年底每桶約100美元，降至2027年底的78美元；貨幣政策方面，則預期聯準會及歐洲央行將在2027年底前後轉向降息。
不過，實際市場走勢與這些預測仍有落差。目前美國10年期公債殖利率達5.12%，在連續兩次公布高於預期的消費者物價指數（CPI）後，週四進一步攀升。高盛經濟學家近期也已將降息預期調整至更晚時間。
油價方面，布蘭特原油週四因美國總統川普表示美國不需要與伊朗達成協議，反彈3.3%至每桶約96美元，中東局勢能否恢復正常，仍存在不確定性。
在區域配置上，高盛最終建議超配美國及日本股市，對亞洲及新興市場維持中性，歐洲則採取低配立場。高盛對歐洲較為保守，主要考量包括油價下跌可能衝擊能源產業獲利、政府債務問題，以及密集政治日程帶來的不確定性。
paras_en: As the AI capital‑expenditure boom may gradually peak, the profit‑growth engine of global equities is expected to slow markedly. Still, Goldman Sachs' latest 2027 Global Equity Strategy Outlook notes that concerns over AI investment returns and capex peaks have forced large valuation revisions, creating positioning opportunities—especially for US large‑cap cloud providers, whose valuations are now even below those of consumer‑staples stocks.

Goldman Sachs chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer writes in the new report "Finding Value in Growth" that AI‑related firms have recently seen steep valuation pull‑backs, reflecting investor worries that AI capex is about to top out and that returns may decelerate, but that this also makes some growth stocks more attractively priced for entry.

US large‑cap cloud providers are currently expected to trade at a price‑to‑earnings (P/E) multiple of about 19.7×, which is below the lower bound of the past 20‑year historical range and also below the 21× multiple of consumer‑staples peers.
Goldman believes these companies now exhibit characteristics of relatively defensive assets.

The report comes as tech stocks are undergoing severe turbulence. The Nasdaq‑100 just suffered its steepest single‑day drop since the COVID‑19 pandemic, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) plunged after news that founder‑CEO Jensen Huang would step down.

Nevertheless, Goldman remains bullish on US equities, forecasting a 12‑month target of 8,700 points for the S&P 500—about a 14% upside from current levels. Regionally, Japan’s TOPIX and broader Asian markets offer the greatest upside potential, while Europe lags with an expected return of only about 6%.

Goldman’s strategy team sees three major trends shaping global equity markets in 2026: more dispersed regional performance, corporate earnings becoming the primary driver of price gains, and a broad downward revision of valuations.

In the past 12 months the long‑standing US lead over other regions has narrowed, with total regional returns converging, though the underlying drivers differ. In Asia (ex‑Japan) and emerging markets, EPS growth over the next year is projected to account for roughly 70% of total returns, while P/E compression will offset more than half of the price appreciation.

Corporate profit growth is expected to stem from three sources: continued expansion in the tech sector, higher oil prices boosting commodity‑producer earnings, and spill‑over effects from tech capex that lift demand in heavy‑asset, low‑turnover industries such as industrials.

Conversely, market valuations are no longer expanding. The S&P 500’s forward P/E is projected to fall from near the top of its 20‑year range to about 18.5×; the MSCI World index is expected to trade at a forward P/E of 15.6× with a PEG of 1.1, close to the 35‑year average—still not crisis‑cheap, but the risk‑adjusted return profile has shifted from the previous over‑valued phase.
Goldman warns that corporate profit growth rates in major markets could fall sharply by 2027.
It estimates S&P 500 earnings growth will drop from 36% to 11%, Europe’s STOXX 600 from 18% to 7%, Japan’s TOPIX from 24% to 9%, and Asian markets from near 80% to under 30%.

Among the drivers, capex changes at ultra‑large cloud providers will be a key factor for US earnings. Goldman calculates that cloud‑giant spending this year contributes 12 percentage points to S&P 500 EPS growth—up from 5 pp in 2025 and 2 pp in 2024.
That contribution is expected to fall to 9 pp in 2027 and could turn negative, at –5 pp, by 2028.

Sector‑wise, IT profit growth is projected to tumble from about 90% to 45%; communications services from +34% to –5%; energy, after a 99% gain this year due to the Iran war, may contract by roughly 10%; and materials earnings are set to slow from 45% to 12%.
Healthcare is the only sector expected to see accelerating profit growth, though it has already undergone a valuation reset.

This suggests that suppliers that previously benefited from the AI capex surge—such as chipmakers, industrial and energy‑equipment firms—may face weaker growth momentum, while US cloud giants, now priced lower and with valuations receding, are back in Goldman’s favor.
Goldman notes that recent value stocks have outperformed growth stocks globally, with the valuation gap between the two narrowing from over 100% at its 2021 peak to roughly 45‑50%.

At the same time, the valuation of the value factor is now near the 90th percentile of its 20‑year range, making value stocks appear even pricier than growth on a historical basis. The global tech sector sits around the 20th percentile of its 20‑year range, with its P/E now close to that of value stocks.

The valuation shift for US large‑cap cloud providers is especially noteworthy: their expected P/E of about 19.7× sits below both the 20‑year historical band and the 21× multiple of consumer‑staples peers.

Moreover, the valuation premium of the five largest US firms relative to the other 495 S&P 500 constituents has largely vanished, no longer reaching the extreme levels seen in 2000 or the 2021 market peaks.

Goldman believes these firms have the hallmarks of defensive growth assets: valuations have fallen, balance sheets remain solid, and revenue streams are diversified. In terms of leverage, developed‑market tech firms have net debt‑to‑equity ratios in single‑digit percentages, versus roughly 50% across the broader market.
Regarding semiconductors, memory and hardware, Goldman sees these high‑cyclical growth segments as volatile but offering high upside potential.

Goldman’s Asia team estimates that South Korean memory stocks already price in a pessimistic 70% earnings downgrade scenario for 2027, yet Goldman thinks this is overly conservative because companies have disclosed that DRAM and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) orders are booked through 2029.
Korean memory stocks now trade at a price‑to‑book of just 0.7× based on 2028 projected book value, a level historically associated with strong future returns.

Nevertheless, Goldman maintains a neutral rating on the overall Asian market, citing concentration risk: South Korea and Taiwan together account for about 50% of the MSCI Emerging Markets index, with the tech sector weighting over 40%; the three AI‑core firms—TSMC (2330‑TW), Samsung Electronics (005930 KS) and SK Hynix (000660 KS)—make up roughly 30% of the index.
With tech stocks so heavily concentrated, the P/E discount of emerging markets versus developed markets has widened to about 50%, the widest gap since at least 2010.
Goldman projects that the price‑return for Asia (ex‑Japan) in USD terms could reach 17%, but the high annualized volatility of 24.2% leads to a risk‑adjusted neutral stance.
One key assumption in Goldman’s 2027 investment outlook is a decline in oil prices and a pull‑back in bond yields.

The commodity team forecasts Brent crude falling from roughly $100 per barrel at the end of 2026 to $78 by the end of 2027, while monetary policy is expected to shift toward rate cuts by the Fed and ECB around year‑end 2027.

However, actual market movements may diverge from these forecasts. US 10‑year Treasury yields are at 5.12% and have risen further after two consecutive CPI releases that exceeded expectations, prompting Goldman economists to push back expected rate‑cut timing.
Brent crude rebounded 3.3% on Thursday to about $96 a barrel after former President Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran, leaving Middle‑East stability uncertain.

In terms of regional allocation, Goldman ultimately recommends overweighting US and Japanese equities, maintaining a neutral stance on Asia and emerging markets, and underweighting Europe. Its cautious view on Europe reflects concerns that lower oil prices could hurt energy earnings, sovereign‑debt issues, and heightened political uncertainty.

items.title: 韓半導體大動作！SK海力士將五年內砸10.5億美元　扶持供應商+龍仁建測試廠
items.title_en: South Korea Semiconductor Giant Makes Big Move! SK Hynix to Spend $1.05 Billion Over Five Years to Support Suppliers and Build Trinity Fab Test Facility in Yongsan
paras: 面對AI晶片市場競爭加劇，南韓記憶體巨頭SK海力士週一(16日)宣布，未來五年將投入1.4兆韓元(約10.5億美元)，用於扶持南韓國內半導體材料、零組件及設備供應商，以強化供應鏈韌性。
SK海力士同步公布一項聯合出資計畫，將在首爾以南的龍仁半導體產業叢集內，興建投資額達8746億韓元的「Trinity Fab」測試設施。該設施由SK海力士出資4432億韓元，南韓中央與地方政府分別出資3736億及577億韓元，預計2027年5月營運。
供應商支援計畫涵蓋研發、測試、量產與銷售四階段，形成完整生態系，中小型供應商可在接近商業量產線的環境中測試產品，有效克服融資與技術障礙。
此舉正值SK集團全面轉向AI戰略的關鍵時刻。根據週日(15日)公開的研討會內容，SK集團會長崔泰源提出「AI飛輪」邏輯：以AI半導體競爭力拉動資料中心擴張，進而帶動能源與AI服務需求，最終反饋推動半導體技術迭代。
SK海力士作為集團AI布局的核心引擎，正將AI與數位孿生技術導入智能工廠升級，透過生產端AI改造提升效率，為後續產能調整與需求擴張奠定穩固基礎。
paras_en: Facing intensified competition in the AI chip market, South Korean memory giant SK Hynix announced on Monday (the 16th) that it will invest 1.4 trillion won (about $1.05 billion) over the next five years to support domestic semiconductor material, component and equipment suppliers, strengthening supply‑chain resilience.

SK Hynix also unveiled a joint‑funding plan to build a "Trinity Fab" testing facility within the Yongsan semiconductor cluster south of Seoul, with a total investment of 874.6 billion won. SK Hynix will contribute 443.2 billion won, while the central and local governments of South Korea will provide 373.6 billion won and 57.7 billion won respectively, and the plant is slated to begin operations in May 2027.

The supplier support program covers four stages—R&D, testing, mass production and sales—creating a complete ecosystem. Small and medium‑sized suppliers can test their products in an environment close to commercial production lines, effectively overcoming financing and technical barriers.

The move comes at a pivotal moment as the SK Group fully pivots to an AI strategy. In a seminar released on Sunday (the 15th), SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won outlined an "AI flywheel" logic: leveraging AI semiconductor competitiveness to drive data‑center expansion, which in turn fuels demand for energy and AI services, ultimately feeding back to accelerate semiconductor technology iteration.

As the core engine of the group’s AI rollout, SK Hynix is integrating AI and digital‑twin technologies into smart‑factory upgrades, using AI‑driven production transformations to boost efficiency and lay a solid foundation for future capacity adjustments and demand growth.

items.title: 輝達循環融資風險被高估？專家揭真相：多數是供應商採購款
items.title_en: Is Nvidia's Circular Financing Risk Overstated? Experts Reveal the Truth: Most Are Supplier Purchase Commitments
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 季度申報文件揭露高達5,305億美元的承諾與或有事項金額，遠高於資產負債表上的910億美元總負債，引發外界對其財務風險及人工智慧（AI）產業循環融資的疑慮。不過，會計專家指出，這些金額多數與循環融資無關，主要是未來支付給供應商的採購承諾，真正與AI建設及客戶融資相關的金額約為2,000億美元。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，市場近期關注輝達的財務承諾，包括揭露的3,660億美元承諾與或有事項、另有560億美元承諾，以及對OpenAI的1,085億美元承諾，合計達5,305億美元。
這個數字遠高於輝達資產負債表所列的910億美元總負債，但更重要的是，這些金額大多與循環融資無關。所謂循環融資，是指輝達提供資金給購買其硬體產品的客戶。
會計專家 Robert Willens 指出，這筆5,305億美元的承諾中，最大部分約2,790億美元，是對記憶體晶片製造商等供應商的未來付款承諾。這些款項將在多年期間陸續支付，並透過損益表反映。
博通(AVGO-US) 也公布類似的採購承諾，金額達1,270億美元，而其資產負債表上的總負債為880億美元。
輝達與博通的採購承諾持續增加，部分原因在於記憶體晶片成本高漲。
不過，分析指出，這兩家公司的相關數字都不至於令人過度擔憂，也沒有偏離合理範圍。輝達的晶片業務規模約為博通的5倍。
若聚焦AI基礎建設相關承諾，輝達的金額約為2,000億美元，其中對OpenAI的承諾就超過1,000億美元。雖然這仍是相當龐大的資金規模，循環融資也確實是值得留意的風險，但AI資料中心大型業者的支出規模以兆美元計，而非僅有數十億美元。
目前AI產業融資主要來自企業現金流、發行股票、債券及貸款。
外界對輝達是否透過放寬融資條件協助客戶購買晶片的質疑，仍有討論空間，但評估相關風險時，必須先釐清數字。輝達對客戶的融資承諾規模更接近2,000億美元，而非外界可能從5,305億美元總額所理解的規模。
目前，輝達未回應外界對其會計處理方式的置評請求。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) disclosed in its quarterly filing commitments and contingent liabilities amounting to a staggering $530.5 billion, far exceeding the $91 billion total debt shown on its balance sheet, sparking concerns about its financial risk and the AI industry’s circular financing. However, accounting experts say most of these amounts are unrelated to circular financing and are mainly future purchase commitments to suppliers, with the portion truly tied to AI build‑out and customer financing around $200 billion.

Baron Weekly reported that the market has recently focused on Nvidia’s financial commitments, including the disclosed $366 billion in commitments and contingencies, an additional $56 billion commitment, and a $108.5 billion commitment to OpenAI, totaling $530.5 billion.

That figure dwarfs the $91 billion total debt listed on Nvidia’s balance sheet, but more importantly, most of the amount has nothing to do with circular financing. Circular financing refers to Nvidia providing funds to customers who purchase its hardware products.

Accounting specialist Robert Willens noted that of the $530.5 billion commitment, the largest portion—about $279 billion—is a future payment obligation to suppliers such as memory‑chip manufacturers. These payments will be made over many years and will be reflected on the income statement.
Broadcom (AVGO-US) also announced similar purchase commitments, amounting to $127 billion, while its balance sheet shows total debt of $88 billion.
The growing purchase commitments of Nvidia and Broadcom are partly driven by the soaring cost of memory chips.
Nevertheless, analysts say the numbers for both companies are not cause for alarm and remain within a reasonable range. Nvidia’s chip business is roughly five times the size of Broadcom’s.

Focusing on AI‑infrastructure‑related commitments, Nvidia’s figure is about $200 billion, with the commitment to OpenAI alone exceeding $100 billion. While still a massive sum and circular financing is a risk to watch, large AI data‑center operators spend on the order of trillions of dollars, not merely tens of billions.
Current AI industry financing mainly comes from corporate cash flow, equity issuances, bonds and loans.

There is still debate about whether Nvidia eases financing terms to help customers buy chips, but when assessing the risk, the numbers must be clarified first. Nvidia’s financing commitments to customers are closer to $200 billion, not the $530.5 billion total that outsiders might assume.
Nvidia has not responded to requests for comment on its accounting treatment.

items.title: 車用晶片誰是老大？高通單季營收暴增89%直逼英飛凌霸主地位 僅差8000萬美元
items.title_en: Who Is the Leader in Automotive Chips? Qualcomm’s Quarterly Revenue Surges 89% Nearing Infineon’s Dominance, Just $80 Million Short
paras: 2026年第三季全球汽車晶片營收排名出爐，英飛凌(Infineon)以23.64億美居冠，恩智浦(NXP)20.70億美元、高通19.9億美元緊追在後，其中恩智浦與高通差距僅約8000萬美元，競爭趨於白熱化。
英飛凌汽車部門營收季增8%、年增9%，佔公司總收入約44%；部門利潤率從18.4%升至22.4%，改善來自銷量增加與產品組合優化，非單季出貨衝高所致。
恩智浦汽車收入佔集團比重高達55%，對車市依賴最深，今年第三季較一年前成長13%，庫存周轉天數從去年同期161天降至148天。
高通表現最為亮眼，汽車收入從去年同期10.53億美元暴增至19.90億美元，年增89%，主要受惠於數位座艙、輔助駕駛及連接平台需求。汽車業務佔QCT收入約22%，能否站穩20億美元關卡，取決於新車型實際裝車量與平台收益轉化。
瑞薩(Renesas)汽車收入12.02億美元，年增19.3%，部門利潤率32.9%，中國車企擴大採用28奈米MCU及日本客戶導入R-Car為主要動能。
安森美(onsemi)今年第三季汽車業務收入7.767億美元，微降1.3%，集團重心漸轉向AI資料中心。德州儀器、義法半導體及ADI本季未披露可直接併列的汽車晶片營收。
隨著各廠財報透明度提升，市場得以更即時掌握車用半導體實際態勢，後續記憶體晶片在汽車領域的漲價效應，亦將成為觀察重點。
paras_en: The Q3 2026 global automotive chip revenue rankings have been released, with Infineon topping the list at $2.364 billion, followed by NXP at $2.070 billion and Qualcomm close behind at $1.990 billion. The gap between NXP and Qualcomm is only about $80 million, making the competition increasingly fierce.

Infineon’s automotive division saw quarterly revenue rise 8% and year‑over‑year growth of 9%, accounting for roughly 44% of the company’s total sales. The division’s profit margin improved from 18.4% to 22.4%, driven by higher volumes and a better product mix rather than a one‑off shipment spike.

Automotive revenue makes up a hefty 55% of NXP’s group sales, reflecting its deep reliance on the car market. In Q3 this year, automotive sales grew 13% compared with a year earlier, and inventory turnover days fell from 161 to 148 days year‑over‑year.

Qualcomm delivered the most striking performance, with automotive revenue soaring from $1.053 billion a year ago to $1.990 billion, an 89% increase. The boost came mainly from demand for digital cockpits, advanced driver‑assist systems and connectivity platforms. Automotive business now represents about 22% of Qualcomm’s QCT revenue, and whether it can sustain the $2 billion threshold will depend on actual fit‑rates in new vehicle models and the conversion of platform earnings.

Renesas reported automotive revenue of $1.202 billion, up 19.3% year‑over‑year, with a division profit margin of 32.9%. Growth was driven by Chinese automakers expanding use of its 28‑nm MCUs and Japanese customers adopting its R‑Car platform.

Onsemi’s automotive business generated $776.7 million in Q3, a slight decline of 1.3%, as the group gradually shifts focus toward AI data‑center applications. Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics and Analog Devices did not disclose automotive‑chip revenue that could be directly compared this quarter.

As companies increase the transparency of their financial reports, the market can now track the real‑time state of automotive semiconductors more accurately. Going forward, the price‑increase impact of memory chips in the automotive sector will also become a key observation point.

items.title: 金融時報：黃仁勳考慮重返輝達 矽谷盟友正在組遊說團
items.title_en: Financial Times: Jensen Huang Mulls Returning to Nvidia as Silicon Valley Allies Form Lobbying Team
paras: 據英國《金融時報》15日（周日）報導，黃仁勳考慮重返輝達(NVDA-US) 擔任執行長，其矽谷盟友正向輝達董事會施壓，要求恢復黃仁勳職務。
多位知情人士透露，黃仁勳已與親信討論過重返輝達的可能性，儘管輝達董事會在展開獨立調查。一名黃仁勳盟友說，他們正組建一個由矽谷企業高層組成的「戰情室」，遊說推動黃仁勳復職，並計劃爭取白宮支持。
這名人士表示：「在科技行業，除了那些前沿AI實驗室之外，所有有影響力的人都喜歡黃仁勳。」他說道，黃仁勳本人支持這項行動。
不過，推動黃仁勳復職的行動可能會遭華盛頓關鍵政策制定者反對。美國財長貝森特15日呼籲黃仁勳離職後，輝達應進行一次高層重大改組。
同時，輝達董事會及臨時執行長科克瑞斯（Colette Kress）正全力在17日發布季度財報前穩住局勢。
即使是黃仁勳盟友也不確定應如何恢復他的聲譽，一名參與推動黃仁勳復職的人士承認：「與下屬發生婚外情足以被解僱。」
paras_en: According to the UK Financial Times on Sunday the 15th, Jensen Huang is considering returning to Nvidia (NVDA-US) as chief executive, with his Silicon Valley allies pressuring Nvidia's board to reinstate him.

Multiple insiders said Huang has discussed the possibility of returning with close confidants, even as Nvidia's board launches an independent investigation. One of Huang's allies said they are setting up a "war room" of senior Silicon Valley executives to lobby for his reinstatement and are planning to seek White House support.
The source added: "In the tech industry, aside from the cutting‑edge AI labs, everyone with influence likes Jensen Huang." He said Huang himself backs the effort.

However, the push to restore Huang could face opposition from key policymakers in Washington. U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen on the 15th called for a major senior‑level reshuffle at Nvidia after Huang’s departure.
At the same time, Nvidia's board and interim CEO Colette Kress are working hard to steady the company ahead of the quarterly earnings release on the 17th.
Even Huang’s allies are unsure how to restore his reputation; a participant in the reinstatement effort admitted: "Having an affair with a subordinate is enough to get you fired."

items.title: 貝森特要求輝達大改組！稱新執行長「應外聘」、10天內交代晶片違規交易疑雲
items.title_en: Bessent Demands Major Overhaul at Nvidia, Calls for Outside CEO and 10-Day Clarification on Alleged Chip Trade Violations
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）周日（15日）表示，輝達(NVDA-US) 在執行長黃仁勳遭撤換後，需要進行「大幅度改組」，並建議董事會從公司外部尋找新任領導人。他也要求輝達董事會及外部法律顧問在未來10天內，釐清公司是否明知存在違法晶片交易警訊，卻仍放任相關行為，以推升營收與獲利。
根據《彭博》報導，貝森特周日接受《福斯新聞》節目Sunday Morning Futures訪問時指出，鑑於輝達接連遭指控協助向中國實體銷售先進人工智慧（AI）晶片，他認為公司應從外部尋找新的領導人。
他說：「這讓我認為，董事會在尋找新任領導人時，應該從公司外部延攬人選。光是公司內部發生的這些事情，就足以說明他們需要進行大幅度的改組。」
貝森特進一步表示，他希望釐清輝達是否刻意忽視警訊，任由空殼公司將晶片轉運至中國。他認為，外界不應只關注黃仁勳個人的私生活問題，而應將焦點轉向輝達涉及的法律及國家安全疑慮。
他說：「我想持續追問的是，輝達內部究竟形成了什麼樣的企業文化？他們是否為了推升營收與獲利，而積極推動這些看似違法的銷售交易？」他並要求董事會及外部法律顧問在未來10天內給出答案。
黃仁勳與新加坡 Megaspeed International 前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）的婚外情曝光，加上美國懷疑黃樂涉及中國間諜活動，使輝達面臨全面檢視。
輝達董事會上周已任命財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）擔任臨時執行長，她也將於周二（17日）主持公司季度財報發布。
貝森特除了要求輝達更換高層，也持續施壓公司釐清內部合規監督問題。他向《福斯新聞》表示，輝達已聘請外部法律顧問，外界應能藉此獲得對公司「不遵守規範文化」的解釋。

貝森特點名商務部長盧特尼克 晶片出口管制遭質疑

貝森特先前曾表示，自己長期支持將 Megaspeed 列入貿易黑名單，但他周日特別點名商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick），指出相關決策權掌握在商務部手中。
他指出，其他多個政府部門都曾推動對 Megaspeed 採取行動，但最終負責主導決策的是商務部。
自黃仁勳上周四（12日）遭撤換以來，負責監督晶片出口及相關管制措施的盧特尼克，也面臨愈來愈多質疑。盧特尼克的發言人上周向《NBC》表示，他已同意赴國會作證。
民主黨議員也要求盧特尼克說明相關決策。美國眾議院民主黨議員海姆斯（Jim Himes）周日接受《CBS》訪問時表示，目前看來，盧特尼克似乎是美國政府內部阻止輝達晶片流向中國的主要阻力，外界需要知道原因。
海姆斯並指出，阻止這類情況發生，是商務部長及總統應負起的責任。
美國國會議員正加大對輝達及川普政府的施壓力道，要求雙方提供更多資訊，說明這家晶片製造商及美國政府是否已充分採取措施，防止中國取得AI晶片。
目前，國會跨黨派議員正支持一項出口管制法案，計畫進一步限制中國取得AI晶片及半導體製造設備，該法案最快可能在數周內獲得通過。
不過，貝森特周日反對將晶片技術出口限制納入法律的主張，包括民主黨議員提出的相關要求。民主黨預計明年1月起在國會取得多數席次。
貝森特表示，美國不需要額外立法，現有規範已經足夠，真正需要的是確實執行。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday the 15th that Nvidia (NVDA-US) must undergo a "significant restructuring" after CEO Jensen Huang’s removal and urged the board to seek a new leader from outside the company. He also demanded that Nvidia’s board and external legal counsel clarify within ten days whether the company knowingly ignored illegal chip‑trade warnings while allowing the activity to boost revenue and profit.

According to Bloomberg, Bessent told Fox News’ Sunday Morning Futures program that, given Nvidia’s repeated accusations of helping sell advanced AI chips to Chinese entities, the company should look outside for new leadership.
He said, "This leads me to believe that the board, when searching for a new leader, should recruit from outside the firm. The internal issues alone are enough to justify a major overhaul."

Bessent added that he wants to determine whether Nvidia deliberately ignored warnings and allowed shell companies to ship chips to China. He argued that the focus should shift from Jensen Huang’s personal matters to the legal and national‑security concerns surrounding Nvidia.

He said, "My ongoing question is what kind of corporate culture has developed inside Nvidia. Are they actively pushing seemingly illegal sales to boost revenue and profit?" He also asked the board and external counsel to provide answers within ten days.

Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair with former Megaspeed International senior executive Alice Huang, coupled with U.S. suspicions that Alice Huang is involved in Chinese espionage, has placed Nvidia under comprehensive scrutiny.
Last week the Nvidia board appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and she will chair the company’s quarterly earnings release on Tuesday the 17th.

Beyond demanding top‑level changes, Bessent continues to pressure Nvidia to clarify its internal compliance oversight. He told Fox News that Nvidia has hired external legal counsel, which should allow outsiders to obtain an explanation of the company’s "non‑compliance culture."
Bessent singled out Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over chip‑export controls, noting that the authority for related decisions rests with the Commerce Department.
He pointed out that several other government agencies have pushed for action against Megaspeed, but the ultimate decision‑making power lies with Commerce.

Since Jensen Huang’s removal on Thursday the 12th, Commerce Secretary Lutnick, who oversees chip export controls, has faced increasing scrutiny. Lutnick’s spokesperson told NBC last week that he has agreed to testify before Congress.

Democratic lawmakers have also demanded explanations from Lutnick. House Democrat Jim Himes told CBS on Sunday that Lutnick appears to be the main internal obstacle to preventing Nvidia chips from reaching China, and the public needs to know why.
Himes added that preventing such transfers is a responsibility that falls on the Commerce Secretary and the President.

Congressional members are intensifying pressure on both Nvidia and the Trump administration, demanding more information on whether the chip maker and the U.S. government have taken sufficient steps to stop China from acquiring AI chips.

Currently, bipartisan lawmakers are backing an export‑control bill that would further restrict China’s access to AI chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, a measure that could pass within weeks.

However, Bessent on Sunday opposed incorporating chip‑technology export restrictions into law, including the demands put forward by Democratic legislators. Democrats expect to gain a majority in Congress starting January next year.
Bessent said the United States does not need additional legislation; existing regulations are sufficient, and the real need is proper enforcement.
This article is not available for partner re‑publication.

items.title: 年輕人首當其衝！澳央行研究：初級崗位正被演算法「吃掉」 尤其是軟體、客服工作
items.title_en: Young Workers Hit First! RBA Study Finds Entry‑Level Jobs Being ‘Eaten’ by Algorithms, Especially in Software and Customer Service
paras: 生成式AI技術飛速發展對全球就業市場的深遠影響正逐步浮現。外媒最新報導指出，儘管目前AI對整體就業市場的衝擊仍屬有限，但對於剛踏入職場的年輕人及從事軟體開發等特定行業的勞動者而言，嚴峻的挑戰已悄然降臨。
《THE DECODER》報導， 根據澳洲央行(RBA)經濟學家Mike Major最新研究，自2022年底ChatGPT問世以來，各類職業的招聘職缺普遍下滑，其中受AI影響程度最高的職業降幅尤為顯著。在這一群體中，15至24歲的年輕勞動者及應屆畢業生，就業率明顯低於資深從業者，失業率也相對偏高。
這一趨勢在國際之間獲得印證。根據史丹佛大學去年8月報告，在美國，22至25歲從事高AI影響職業的年輕人就業人數減少了13%，其中年輕軟體開發人員的降幅更逼近20%。相較之下，經驗豐富的資深員工就業狀況基本穩定，部分甚至有所改善。
然而，專家提醒，目前尚不能將就業低迷完全歸咎於AI。Major強調，研究衡量的是職業「理論上受AI影響的程度」，而非企業實際應用情況。疫後經濟週期變化、遠端辦公模式調整及Fed貨幣政策轉向等宏觀經濟因素，可能扮演了更關鍵的角色。
美國匹茲堡大學的研究亦發現，受AI影響較大的職業，就業問題早在2022年初(ChatGPT發布前數月)就已顯現。
值得注意的是，AI不僅是替代者，也是新需求的創造者。根據即將於本周IPO的Anthropic內部數據，該公司技術崗位中初級員工佔比從2025年初的27%驟降至9%，但AI智能體執行任務的時間已達人類員工的6倍。這引發了對「認知公地悲劇」的擔憂。也就是若企業持續削減初級崗位，未來可能出現資深專業人才斷層。
儘管如此，AI同時催生了大量新機會。根據LinkedIn數據，一年內平台上AI相關招聘資訊暴增6倍。
世界經濟論壇(WEF)預測指出，到2030年全球就業崗位將淨增7800萬個，77%的企業將員工技能提升列為優先事項。
綜合來看，AI對就業市場的影響並非簡單的「崗位消失」，而是一場結構性的重塑。對於缺乏經驗的年輕人而言，傳統的入門崗位競爭將更加激烈；而對於整個社會，如何透過技能再培訓來適應AI時代的新需求，將是未來十年的關鍵課題。
paras_en: The rapid development of generative AI is beginning to reveal its profound impact on the global labour market. Foreign media reports note that while AI’s overall effect on employment is still limited, severe challenges are quietly emerging for young people just entering the workforce and for workers in specific sectors such as software development.

According to a report by THE DECODER, RBA economist Mike Major’s latest research shows that since the debut of ChatGPT at the end of 2022, job openings across many occupations have generally declined, with the steepest drops in roles most affected by AI. Within this group, workers aged 15‑24 and recent graduates have noticeably lower employment rates than senior staff and relatively higher unemployment rates.

The trend is confirmed internationally. A Stanford University report from last August found that in the United States, employment among 22‑25‑year‑olds in high‑AI‑impact jobs fell by 13%, with the decline for young software developers approaching 20%. By contrast, employment for experienced senior employees remained largely stable, with some even improving.

However, experts caution that the current employment slowdown cannot be blamed entirely on AI. Major stresses that the study measures the “theoretical” susceptibility of occupations to AI, not the actual level of corporate adoption. Post‑pandemic economic cycle shifts, changes in remote‑work practices and the Fed’s monetary‑policy turn‑around may play more decisive roles.
Research from the University of Pittsburgh also found that employment problems in AI‑sensitive occupations were evident as early as early 2022, months before ChatGPT’s release.

It is noteworthy that AI is not only a substitute but also a creator of new demand. Internal data from Anthropic, which is set to IPO this week, shows the share of junior staff in its technical roles plummeted from 27% at the start of 2025 to 9%, while AI agents now spend six times as much time on tasks as human employees. This raises concerns about a “tragedy of the cognitive commons,” i.e., if firms keep cutting entry‑level positions, a future shortage of senior expertise could emerge.
Nevertheless, AI is also spawning a wealth of new opportunities. LinkedIn data indicate that AI‑related job postings on the platform have surged six‑fold within a year.
The World Economic Forum predicts that by 2030 the global job market will see a net increase of 78 million positions, and 77% of companies will prioritize upskilling their workforce.

Overall, AI’s impact on employment is not a simple case of “job disappearance” but a structural reshaping. For inexperienced young workers, competition for traditional entry‑level roles will intensify; for society as a whole, the key challenge over the next decade will be how to use reskilling to meet the new demands of the AI era.

items.title: 美股今年還有聖誕行情嗎？高盛警告通膨未退、明年1月恐掀價格重訂潮
items.title_en: Will the U.S. Stock Market Still Have a Christmas Rally This Year? Goldman Sachs Warns Inflation Won’t Subside, January Next Year May Trigger a Price‑Reset Wave
paras: 美股經歷劇烈修正後，市場籌碼與估值逐步修復，高盛、摩根士丹利及摩根大通均看好年末反彈，認為投資人減碼、空頭部位增加及季節性因素有利行情回升。不過，高盛警告，全球上游通膨壓力持續累積，部分指標甚至超越疫情期間高峰，相關成本恐在明年第一季轉嫁至消費端，為市場帶來新一輪考驗。
根據高盛11月13日發布的最新總體經濟報告，策略師Cosimo Codacci-Pisanelli以「聖誕節能否提早到來？」為題，認為近期股市大幅回檔、估值倍數收縮、投資部位明顯降低，加上季節性支撐，已為年底風險資產反彈創造條件。
摩根士丹利的數據也顯示，人工智慧（AI）類股正經歷逾15年來最大規模的集中平倉與去槓桿；摩根大通則建議客戶趁市場下跌時買進。
然而，當華爾街主要機構幾乎同時看好年末反彈，原本可能由空頭回補推動的行情，也可能演變成另一筆過度擁擠的共識交易。
Codacci-Pisanelli甚至在報告中提醒，2026年市場最有效的操作策略，反而是「放空每一筆共識交易」。

避險基金大幅減碼 AI部位轉為低配

高盛看好美股反彈的首要理由，是市場經歷一輪劇烈去槓桿後，投資部位已大幅出清。
高盛指出，這波去槓桿的激烈程度，是過去10年來最嚴重的階段之一，其美國優先經紀業務帳簿中的淨部位與總部位同步大幅縮減。當輝達(NVDA-US) 董事會尋找執行長黃仁勳接班人的消息衝擊市場時，那斯達克指數單日跌幅更達到約5個標準差。
摩根士丹利的數據也印證市場籌碼出現大幅調整。根據《彭博》報導，摩根士丹利優先經紀業務資料顯示，避險基金持有的AI類股淨部位近期已轉為低於基準配置，這是2023年以來首見；本輪避險基金去槓桿持續時間，更創下逾15年來最長紀錄。
摩根大通上周也向客戶表示，目前市場情緒「相當糟糕」，但這反而應該被視為看多訊號。
高盛進一步指出，市場在短短一周內已消化多項利空，包括高於預期的消費者物價指數（CPI）、聯準會偏鷹派的談話、利率走高、油價上漲，以及輝達相關負面消息，但股價仍相對穩定。
在高盛看來，這代表市場賣壓可能已接近枯竭。當願意賣出的投資人逐漸減少，即使後續再出現壞消息，也未必能進一步大幅壓低股價，反而可能為空頭回補創造條件。

全球股市估值回落 盈利預期卻持續上修

估值修正是高盛看好反彈的另一項重要依據。
Codacci-Pisanelli指出，經過近期本益比收縮，全球股市估值已回到35年長期歷史均值附近。MSCI全球指數未來12個月預估本益比降至15.6倍，股價盈餘成長比（PEG）則降至1.1倍，兩項指標都接近1997年以來的歷史平均水準。
更值得注意的是，市場並未同步下修企業獲利預期。投資人對2026年、2027年，尤其是2028年的每股盈餘（EPS）共識預估，近期反而以超越歷史正常速度持續上調。
高盛形容，2028年的獲利預測曲線看起來更像一檔迷因股（meme stock），而不是一般的企業獲利預測線。
此外，在目前實質利率偏高的環境下，美股絕對估值也不再顯得過度昂貴。高盛以標普500指數遠期本益比與10年期實質利率進行迴歸分析，發現目前10年期實質利率約為2.25%，對應的合理本益比約18.9倍，但標普500目前實際交易本益比約17.9倍，低於模型估值約1倍。
高盛坦言，AI產業未來兩年的發展前景仍高度不確定，第四季財報季將是檢驗需求的重要時點。不過，在財報季到來前的6周內，市場可能缺乏新的恐慌性催化因素，這種環境正是空頭回補行情容易形成的條件。

通膨壓力超越疫情高峰 化工、塑膠等成本全面升溫

相較於年末反彈的樂觀預期，高盛報告中更值得關注的警訊，是通膨壓力正在全球供應鏈上游快速累積。
Codacci-Pisanelli指出，美國9月與10月CPI連續高於市場預期，而且超預期的情況並非集中在少數項目，而是廣泛出現在不同價格類別。
全球製造業進口價格通膨，以近6個月年化速度計算，目前約達24%，已明顯超越2021至2022年新冠疫情期間的通膨高峰；全球生產者物價指數（PPI）年化漲幅也達約11%。
更令人擔憂的是，通膨壓力已不再局限於能源與AI硬體，而是逐漸向下游產業擴散，包括化學品、塑膠及紙製品等類別。
高盛數據顯示，美國、德國、法國、義大利及英國的進口價格項目中，年化漲幅超過5%的比例已升至約25%至40%；美國生產者物價中，漲幅超過5%的項目比例更突破40%，這種情況上一次出現，正是2021至2022年通膨浪潮爆發前夕。
周五公布的PPI數據也未能消除相關疑慮。美國10月PPI月增0.3%，略低於市場預期，但年增率仍達6.5%，顯示價格壓力依然顯著。此前周二公布的CPI數據，在70份市場預測中，實際結果僅低於其中1份，反映通膨超出預期的程度相當廣泛。
高盛認為，企業目前仍透過壓縮利潤率吸收投入成本上漲，暫時避免將全部成本轉嫁給消費者，但這種緩衝機制究竟還能維持多久，將是接下來的重要觀察重點。

明年1月恐迎價格重訂潮 聯準會升息預測上修

高盛警告，上游價格壓力通常需要6至12個月，才會完全傳導至消費端，意味著目前累積的通膨成本，可能在明年第一季逐步浮現。
其中，明年1月尤其值得留意。高盛過去曾針對「1月價格重訂效應」進行詳細統計，發現歷史上1月是全年價格項目出現大幅調整最集中的月份，平均約有16個價格項目在當月出現超過2個標準差的漲幅，其他月份通常不超過2.5個。
歐洲市場也呈現類似季節性現象。自新冠疫情以來，1月核心調和消費者物價指數（HICP）通常是全年漲幅最大的月份之一。
在通膨壓力持續升高之際，高盛經濟學家也已在最新CPI數據公布後，上修聯準會升息預測，將原先預期的升息次數再增加一次。
Codacci-Pisanelli另外指出，市場還存在一項可能加劇通膨的反饋效應：先前各國央行之所以傾向採取較寬鬆的政策，很大程度上是因為股市下跌及信用環境緊縮帶來經濟壓力。
但如果股市止跌回升，金融環境隨之轉趨寬鬆，央行繼續維持觀望的理由也可能減少。
換言之，若年底空頭回補行情真的帶動股市反彈，金融環境改善反而可能增加央行持續緊縮政策的空間，讓市場提前消耗未來的上漲動能，形成反彈過後的修正風險。
在利率交易方面，高盛認為，將做多短期通膨納入投資組合，是目前值得考慮的配置方向。
Codacci-Pisanelli也坦言，2026年對總體經濟交易員而言是相當艱難的一年，幾乎每一種資產類別都暗藏風險。回頭檢視全年市場表現，最有效的操作原則反而是「放空每一筆共識交易」。
他在報告結尾提醒，即使年末聖誕行情如期到來，能源衝擊已使中間財PPI漲幅超過最終需求價格漲幅一倍，製造業進口價格上漲速度也已超越疫情通膨高峰，各大企業正等待明年1月重新調整價格。
這意味著，無論美股年末反彈能否實現，通膨成本帶來的考驗都不會因此消失，相關帳單仍可能在明年第一季如期到來。
報告最後更是以一句「祝你好運」作結。
paras_en: After a sharp correction, U.S. equities are seeing market positioning and valuations gradually recover. Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan all see a year‑end bounce, citing investor de‑risking, rising short positions and seasonal factors as supportive. However, Goldman warns that upstream global inflation pressures are still building, with some indicators even surpassing pandemic‑era peaks, and related costs could be passed on to consumers in the first quarter of next year, creating a new round of challenges for the market.

In its latest macro‑economic report released on November 13, Goldman strategist Cosimo Codacci‑Pisanelli titled his note “Will Christmas Arrive Early?” and argued that the recent steep market pull‑back, valuation compression, markedly reduced investment exposure and seasonal support have set the stage for a risk‑asset rebound at year‑end.
Morgan Stanley data also show that AI‑related stocks are undergoing the largest concentrated unwind and deleveraging in more than 15 years; JPMorgan, meanwhile, advises clients to buy on the dip.

Yet, when Wall Street’s major houses almost simultaneously bet on a year‑end bounce, a rally that might have been driven by short covering could instead turn into another overly crowded consensus trade.
Codacci‑Pisanelli even cautions in the report that the most effective strategy in 2026 may be to “short every consensus trade.”

Hedge funds have sharply cut AI exposure, shifting to underweight positions. Goldman’s primary reason for a U.S. equity bounce is that after a fierce round of deleveraging, investment positions have been largely cleared out.

Goldman notes that the intensity of this deleveraging is among the most severe in the past decade, with net and gross positions in its U.S.‑focused brokerage book both shrinking sharply. When Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) board began searching for a successor to CEO Jensen Huang, the Nasdaq fell about five standard deviations in a single day.

Morgan Stanley’s data corroborate a major shift in market positioning. Bloomberg reports that its brokerage data show hedge funds’ net AI stock positions have recently fallen below benchmark allocations – the first time since 2023 – and the current round of hedge‑fund deleveraging is the longest in over 15 years.
JPMorgan told clients last week that market sentiment is “quite terrible,” but that this should actually be taken as a bullish signal.

Goldman further points out that in just one week the market has digested several negative catalysts, including higher‑than‑expected CPI, hawkish Fed commentary, rising rates, higher oil prices and Nvidia‑related bad news, yet stock prices have remained relatively stable.

In Goldman’s view, this suggests selling pressure may be near exhaustion. As investors willing to sell dwindle, even further bad news may not be able to push prices down dramatically, potentially setting the stage for short covering.
Valuation pull‑back is another key reason Goldman sees a bounce ahead.

Codacci‑Pisanelli notes that after the recent P/E compression, global equity valuations have returned to near the 35‑year historical average. The MSCI World index is projected to have a forward P/E of 15.6× over the next 12 months, with a PEG of 1.1× – both close to the historical averages since 1997.

More noteworthy is that earnings expectations have not been trimmed in tandem. Consensus EPS forecasts for 2026, 2027 and especially 2028 have recently been revised upward at a pace that exceeds normal historical rates.
Goldman describes the 2028 earnings forecast curve as looking more like a meme stock than a typical corporate earnings trajectory.

Moreover, in today’s environment of relatively high real rates, U.S. equity absolute valuations no longer appear overly expensive. Using a regression of the S&P 500 forward P/E against the 10‑year real rate, Goldman finds that a 10‑year real rate of about 2.25% implies a fair P/E of roughly 18.9×, while the S&P 500 currently trades at about 17.9× – about one point below the model’s estimate.

Goldman admits that the outlook for the AI sector over the next two years remains highly uncertain, and the Q4 earnings season will be a crucial test of demand. However, in the six weeks leading up to earnings, the market may lack new panic‑driving catalysts, creating fertile ground for short‑covering rallies.
A more concerning signal in the report is that inflation pressures are rapidly building upstream in global supply chains, outpacing the pandemic peak.

Codacci‑Pisanelli points out that U.S. CPI for September and October came in well above market expectations, and the overshoot was broad‑based across many price categories, not limited to a few items.

Global manufacturing import‑price inflation, calculated on a six‑month annualised basis, is now around 24%, clearly exceeding the peak inflation seen during the 2021‑2022 COVID period; the global producer‑price index (PPI) is also up about 11% year‑on‑year.
Worryingly, inflation pressure is no longer confined to energy and AI hardware but is spreading downstream to chemicals, plastics, paper and similar categories.

Goldman data show that in the U.S., Germany, France, Italy and the U.K., the share of import‑price items with annualised increases above 5% has risen to roughly 25‑40%; in U.S. producer‑price data, the share of items rising over 5% has broken 40%, a level last seen just before the 2021‑2022 inflation surge.

Friday’s PPI release did little to allay concerns. U.S. October PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly below expectations, but the year‑over‑year rate remained at 6.5%, indicating persistent price pressure. The prior Tuesday’s CPI data fell short of 69 of 70 market forecasts, underscoring how widely inflation exceeded expectations.

Goldman believes companies are still absorbing higher input costs by compressing margins, temporarily avoiding a full pass‑through to consumers, but how long this buffer can hold will be a key watch‑point moving forward.

Goldman warns that upstream price pressure typically takes six to twelve months to fully transmit to consumers, meaning the accumulated inflation cost could start surfacing in the first quarter of next year.

January next year is especially worth watching. Goldman’s historical analysis of the “January price‑reset effect” shows that January has historically been the month with the most concentrated price adjustments across the year, with an average of about 16 price items moving more than two standard deviations higher, a level not usually seen in other months.
European markets exhibit a similar seasonal pattern. Since the pandemic, the January core HICP has often been one of the strongest‑rising months of the year.
Amid rising inflation pressure, Goldman economists have already upgraded their Fed rate‑hike forecasts after the latest CPI release, adding an extra hike to their original projection.

Codacci‑Pisanelli adds that a feedback loop could further amplify inflation: central banks previously pursued relatively accommodative policies largely because falling equity markets and tightening credit conditions were weighing on the economy.
If equities stop falling and start rising, the financial environment may loosen, reducing the central banks’ incentive to stay on the sidelines.

In other words, if a short‑covering rally at year‑end does lift stocks, the resulting improvement in financial conditions could give central banks more room to keep tightening, potentially draining future upside and creating a correction risk after the bounce.
Regarding rate trades, Goldman sees adding short‑term inflation exposure to portfolios as a worthwhile positioning right now.

Codacci‑Pisanelli admits that 2026 will be a very tough year for macro traders, with almost every asset class hiding risks. Looking back at the year’s performance, the most effective rule turned out to be “short every consensus trade.”

He concludes that even if a Christmas rally materialises as expected, energy shocks have already pushed intermediate‑goods PPI growth to twice the final‑demand price increase, manufacturing import prices are rising faster than the pandemic‑era peak, and many firms are poised to reset prices in January next year.

This means that regardless of whether the U.S. market rebounds at year‑end, the test from inflation‑driven cost pressures will not disappear, and related bills are likely to arrive in the first quarter of next year as anticipated.
The report ends with a simple “Good luck.”

items.title: 中方宣布：習近平將同川普、普丁舉行美中俄元首會談
items.title_en: China Announces: Xi Jinping to Hold US‑China‑Russia Leaders’ Meeting with Trump and Putin
paras: 中國外交部發言人16日（周一）宣布，國家主席習近平19日將同美國總統川普、俄羅斯總統普丁在深圳舉行美中俄元首會談。
據《美聯社》報導，白宮13日已經確認，川普、習近平與普丁將於19日在亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）場邊舉行三方會談。
美國資深官員表示，川普計劃與習近平、普丁討論伊朗戰事，但將避開烏克蘭議題。
該官員說，三方會談旨在開啟核裁軍對話，是對話的開端，不預期會宣布任何協議。
亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）是亞太地區最重要經貿合作論壇，2026年系列活動由中國第三度主辦，領袖非正式會議將於18至19日在深圳登場，大國元首場邊會晤、領袖大合照等環節均為看點。
paras_en: Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson announced Monday the 16th that President Xi Jinping will hold a US‑China‑Russia leaders’ meeting with US President Trump and Russian President Putin in Shenzhen on the 19th.
According to the Associated Press, the White House confirmed on the 13th that Trump, Xi and Putin will hold a three‑way talks on the sidelines of the APEC summit on the 19th.
A senior U.S. official said Trump plans to discuss the war in Iran with Xi and Putin, but will avoid the Ukraine issue.
The official said the trilateral talks aim to launch a nuclear‑disarmament dialogue, marking the start of talks, and no agreements are expected to be announced.

The Asia‑Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum is the region’s most important trade and investment platform; 2026’s series of events is being hosted by China for the third time, with the leaders’ informal meeting taking place in Shenzhen on 18‑19 November, and the heads‑of‑state side‑by‑side meeting and group photo are among the highlights.

items.title: 高盛看好美國雲端巨頭成「防禦性資產」！AI資本支出2027恐見頂、獲利成長「大減速」
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Sees US Cloud Giants as "Defensive Assets"; AI Capex May Peak by 2027, Profit Growth to Slow Sharply
paras: 隨著人工智慧（AI）資本支出熱潮可能逐步觸頂，全球股市獲利成長動能預料將明顯放緩。不過，高盛（Goldman Sachs）最新發布的2027年全球股票策略展望指出，市場對AI投資回報及資本支出見頂的疑慮，已促使相關企業估值大幅修正，反而創造布局機會，尤其是遭市場拋售的美國大型雲端服務商，現階段估值甚至低於必需消費品類股。
高盛首席全球股票策略師Peter Oppenheimer在最新報告《Finding Value in Growth》中指出，AI相關企業近期經歷顯著估值回檔，反映投資人擔憂AI資本支出即將見頂，以及相關投資的回報速度可能放緩，但這也讓部分成長股出現更具吸引力的進場價格。
其中，美國大型雲端服務商目前預期本益比約19.7倍，不僅低於過去20年的歷史區間下緣，也低於必需消費品類股的21倍。
高盛認為，這類企業已具備相對防禦型資產的特質。
這份報告發布之際，科技股正面臨劇烈震盪。那斯達克100指數剛經歷新冠疫情以來最嚴重的單日跌幅，輝達(NVDA-US) 也因創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳離職消息衝擊而大幅下跌。
儘管如此，高盛仍看好美股後市，預估未來12個月標普500指數目標價為8700點，較目前水準有約14%上漲空間。區域市場方面，日本東證指數及亞洲市場預期上行空間最大，歐洲則相對落後，預期報酬率僅約6%。

全球股市漲勢轉向獲利支撐 估值擴張動能減弱

高盛策略團隊認為，2026年全球股市呈現三大趨勢：區域市場表現更加分散、企業獲利成為股價上漲的主要支柱，以及各市場估值普遍下修。
過去12個月，美股長期領先其他市場的格局有所改變，各地區股票總報酬率逐漸接近，但背後的驅動因素並不相同。亞洲（不含日本）及新興市場的未來12個月每股盈餘（EPS）成長，約貢獻整體報酬的70%，但本益比下修則抵銷逾半數漲幅。
企業獲利成長主要來自三大來源，包括科技產業持續成長、油價上漲帶動大宗商品生產商獲利，以及科技資本支出外溢效應，進一步推升工業等重資產、低淘汰率產業的需求。
另一方面，市場估值已不再持續擴張。標普500指數預期本益比從接近過去20年區間頂端的水準，回落至18.5倍；MSCI 全世界指數目前預期本益比為15.6倍，股價盈餘成長比（PEG）為1.1，接近過去35年平均值，雖然沒有便宜到危機水準，但相較於先前的高估值階段，風險收益比發生了變化。

AI資本支出放緩 2027年企業獲利成長恐大幅減速

高盛警告，2027年全球主要市場的企業獲利成長率可能普遍明顯下滑。
高盛預估，標普500企業獲利成長率將從36%降至11%，歐洲STOXX 600指數從18%降至7%，日本東證指數從24%降至9%，亞洲市場則從接近80%降至不到30%。
其中，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出變化，將成為影響美股獲利的重要因素。高盛估算，雲端巨頭資本支出今年對標普500每股盈餘成長的貢獻達12個百分點，高於2025年的5個百分點及2024年的2個百分點。
然而，這項貢獻預計2027年降至9個百分點，2028年更可能轉為負5個百分點。
產業方面，資訊科技業獲利成長率預計從接近90%降至45%；通訊服務業則從成長34%轉為衰退5%。能源業今年受伊朗戰爭影響，獲利預估成長99%，但之後可能收縮約10%；材料業獲利成長率則將從45%放緩至12%。
醫療保健業是唯一預期獲利成長加速的產業，但該板塊已經歷一波估值重估。
這代表過去受惠於AI資本支出熱潮的晶片、工業及能源設備等供應商，未來可能面臨成長動能減弱的壓力；相較之下，負責投入資本支出的美國雲端巨頭，卻因股價修正、估值回落，重新受到高盛青睞。

美國雲端巨頭估值低於必需消費品 成長股浮現投資價值

高盛指出，近期價值股在全球各地普遍優於成長股，價值股與成長股之間的估值差距，已從2021年高峰時超過100%，縮小至約45%至50%。
同時，目前價值因子估值已接近過去20年區間的第90百分位，從歷史相對估值來看，甚至比成長股更貴。全球科技板塊則位於過去20年估值區間的第20百分位，本益比已接近價值股。
美國大型雲端服務商的估值變化尤其值得注意，目前預期本益比約19.7倍，不僅低於過去20年歷史區間，也低於必需消費品類股的21倍。
此外，美股前五大企業相較其餘495家標普500成分股的估值溢價，也幾乎收斂，不再如2000年或2021年市場高峰時期般處於極端水準。
高盛認為，這些企業具備成為防禦型成長資產的條件，除了估值已經回落，資產負債表仍相對健全，營收來源也較為多元。以負債情況來看，已開發市場科技產業的淨負債對股東權益比僅個位數，整體市場則約為50%。

半導體、記憶體估值遭低估 高盛看好韓國DRAM及HBM需求

至於半導體、記憶體及硬體產業，高盛認為，這些具備高度景氣循環特性的成長板塊，雖然波動較大，但也蘊藏較高的潛在報酬。
高盛亞洲策略團隊估算，南韓記憶體產業目前股價，已反映市場預期2027年共識獲利下修70%的悲觀情境，但高盛認為這項預期可能過於保守，原因是相關企業已披露，DRAM及高頻寬記憶體（HBM）產品訂單已經排滿至2029年。
目前韓國記憶體類股股價淨值比僅0.7倍，以2028年預估淨值計算。高盛指出，這種估值水準在歷史上往往預示著較佳的未來報酬。
不過，高盛對亞洲市場整體仍維持中性評級，主要考量是市場集中度風險。南韓與台灣合計占MSCI新興市場指數約50%，資訊科技產業權重更超過40%；台積電(2330-TW) 、三星電子(005930KS) 及SK海力士(000660KS) 三家AI核心企業，合計占指數約30%。
在科技股高度集中的情況下，新興市場相較已開發市場的本益比折價已擴大至約50%，創下至少2010年以來最大差距。
高盛預估，亞洲（不含日本）市場以美元計算的價格報酬率可達17%，但考量年化波動率高達24.2%，經風險調整後仍維持中性配置。

油價、債券殖利率走勢成變數 高盛建議加碼美日股市

高盛2027年投資策略的另一項重要假設，是油價下跌及債券殖利率回落。
高盛大宗商品團隊預估，布蘭特原油價格將從2026年底每桶約100美元，降至2027年底的78美元；貨幣政策方面，則預期聯準會及歐洲央行將在2027年底前後轉向降息。
不過，實際市場走勢與這些預測仍有落差。目前美國10年期公債殖利率達5.12%，在連續兩次公布高於預期的消費者物價指數（CPI）後，週四進一步攀升。高盛經濟學家近期也已將降息預期調整至更晚時間。
油價方面，布蘭特原油週四因美國總統川普表示美國不需要與伊朗達成協議，反彈3.3%至每桶約96美元，中東局勢能否恢復正常，仍存在不確定性。
在區域配置上，高盛最終建議超配美國及日本股市，對亞洲及新興市場維持中性，歐洲則採取低配立場。高盛對歐洲較為保守，主要考量包括油價下跌可能衝擊能源產業獲利、政府債務問題，以及密集政治日程帶來的不確定性。
paras_en: As the AI capital‑expenditure boom may gradually peak, the profit‑growth engine of global equities is expected to slow markedly. Still, Goldman Sachs' latest 2027 Global Equity Strategy Outlook notes that concerns over AI investment returns and capex peaks have forced large valuation revisions, creating positioning opportunities—especially for US large‑cap cloud providers, whose valuations are now even below those of consumer‑staples stocks.

Goldman Sachs chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer writes in the new report "Finding Value in Growth" that AI‑related firms have recently seen steep valuation pull‑backs, reflecting investor worries that AI capex is about to top out and that returns may decelerate, but that this also makes some growth stocks more attractively priced for entry.

US large‑cap cloud providers are currently expected to trade at a price‑to‑earnings (P/E) multiple of about 19.7×, which is below the lower bound of the past 20‑year historical range and also below the 21× multiple of consumer‑staples peers.
Goldman believes these companies now exhibit characteristics of relatively defensive assets.

The report comes as tech stocks are undergoing severe turbulence. The Nasdaq‑100 just suffered its steepest single‑day drop since the COVID‑19 pandemic, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) plunged after news that founder‑CEO Jensen Huang would step down.

Nevertheless, Goldman remains bullish on US equities, forecasting a 12‑month target of 8,700 points for the S&P 500—about a 14% upside from current levels. Regionally, Japan’s TOPIX and broader Asian markets offer the greatest upside potential, while Europe lags with an expected return of only about 6%.

Goldman’s strategy team sees three major trends shaping global equity markets in 2026: more dispersed regional performance, corporate earnings becoming the primary driver of price gains, and a broad downward revision of valuations.

In the past 12 months the long‑standing US lead over other regions has narrowed, with total regional returns converging, though the underlying drivers differ. In Asia (ex‑Japan) and emerging markets, EPS growth over the next year is projected to account for roughly 70% of total returns, while P/E compression will offset more than half of the price appreciation.

Corporate profit growth is expected to stem from three sources: continued expansion in the tech sector, higher oil prices boosting commodity‑producer earnings, and spill‑over effects from tech capex that lift demand in heavy‑asset, low‑turnover industries such as industrials.

Conversely, market valuations are no longer expanding. The S&P 500’s forward P/E is projected to fall from near the top of its 20‑year range to about 18.5×; the MSCI World index is expected to trade at a forward P/E of 15.6× with a PEG of 1.1, close to the 35‑year average—still not crisis‑cheap, but the risk‑adjusted return profile has shifted from the previous over‑valued phase.
Goldman warns that corporate profit growth rates in major markets could fall sharply by 2027.
It estimates S&P 500 earnings growth will drop from 36% to 11%, Europe’s STOXX 600 from 18% to 7%, Japan’s TOPIX from 24% to 9%, and Asian markets from near 80% to under 30%.

Among the drivers, capex changes at ultra‑large cloud providers will be a key factor for US earnings. Goldman calculates that cloud‑giant spending this year contributes 12 percentage points to S&P 500 EPS growth—up from 5 pp in 2025 and 2 pp in 2024.
That contribution is expected to fall to 9 pp in 2027 and could turn negative, at –5 pp, by 2028.

Sector‑wise, IT profit growth is projected to tumble from about 90% to 45%; communications services from +34% to –5%; energy, after a 99% gain this year due to the Iran war, may contract by roughly 10%; and materials earnings are set to slow from 45% to 12%.
Healthcare is the only sector expected to see accelerating profit growth, though it has already undergone a valuation reset.

This suggests that suppliers that previously benefited from the AI capex surge—such as chipmakers, industrial and energy‑equipment firms—may face weaker growth momentum, while US cloud giants, now priced lower and with valuations receding, are back in Goldman’s favor.
Goldman notes that recent value stocks have outperformed growth stocks globally, with the valuation gap between the two narrowing from over 100% at its 2021 peak to roughly 45‑50%.

At the same time, the valuation of the value factor is now near the 90th percentile of its 20‑year range, making value stocks appear even pricier than growth on a historical basis. The global tech sector sits around the 20th percentile of its 20‑year range, with its P/E now close to that of value stocks.

The valuation shift for US large‑cap cloud providers is especially noteworthy: their expected P/E of about 19.7× sits below both the 20‑year historical band and the 21× multiple of consumer‑staples peers.

Moreover, the valuation premium of the five largest US firms relative to the other 495 S&P 500 constituents has largely vanished, no longer reaching the extreme levels seen in 2000 or the 2021 market peaks.

Goldman believes these firms have the hallmarks of defensive growth assets: valuations have fallen, balance sheets remain solid, and revenue streams are diversified. In terms of leverage, developed‑market tech firms have net debt‑to‑equity ratios in single‑digit percentages, versus roughly 50% across the broader market.
Regarding semiconductors, memory and hardware, Goldman sees these high‑cyclical growth segments as volatile but offering high upside potential.

Goldman’s Asia team estimates that South Korean memory stocks already price in a pessimistic 70% earnings downgrade scenario for 2027, yet Goldman thinks this is overly conservative because companies have disclosed that DRAM and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) orders are booked through 2029.
Korean memory stocks now trade at a price‑to‑book of just 0.7× based on 2028 projected book value, a level historically associated with strong future returns.

Nevertheless, Goldman maintains a neutral rating on the overall Asian market, citing concentration risk: South Korea and Taiwan together account for about 50% of the MSCI Emerging Markets index, with the tech sector weighting over 40%; the three AI‑core firms—TSMC (2330‑TW), Samsung Electronics (005930 KS) and SK Hynix (000660 KS)—make up roughly 30% of the index.
With tech stocks so heavily concentrated, the P/E discount of emerging markets versus developed markets has widened to about 50%, the widest gap since at least 2010.
Goldman projects that the price‑return for Asia (ex‑Japan) in USD terms could reach 17%, but the high annualized volatility of 24.2% leads to a risk‑adjusted neutral stance.
One key assumption in Goldman’s 2027 investment outlook is a decline in oil prices and a pull‑back in bond yields.

The commodity team forecasts Brent crude falling from roughly $100 per barrel at the end of 2026 to $78 by the end of 2027, while monetary policy is expected to shift toward rate cuts by the Fed and ECB around year‑end 2027.

However, actual market movements may diverge from these forecasts. US 10‑year Treasury yields are at 5.12% and have risen further after two consecutive CPI releases that exceeded expectations, prompting Goldman economists to push back expected rate‑cut timing.
Brent crude rebounded 3.3% on Thursday to about $96 a barrel after former President Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran, leaving Middle‑East stability uncertain.

In terms of regional allocation, Goldman ultimately recommends overweighting US and Japanese equities, maintaining a neutral stance on Asia and emerging markets, and underweighting Europe. Its cautious view on Europe reflects concerns that lower oil prices could hurt energy earnings, sovereign‑debt issues, and heightened political uncertainty.

items.title: 中國車市競爭對手太多 日產高層：新車保鮮期僅3個月
items.title_en: Too Many Competitors in China's Car Market, Nissan Executive: New Car Freshness Period Only 3 Months
paras: 「日產在中國完整的新能源產品矩陣已經逐步成型，包括純電、增程、插混動力形式，以及SUV、轎車、皮卡車型。我們希望大家通過產品，可以感覺到、認識到日產在中國的煥新和改變。」日產中國管理委員會主席、東風汽車有限公司總裁馬智欣如是說道。
馬智欣坦言，公司目前整體銷量上仍面臨壓力。「去年N7出來前幾個月賣得很好，這是我們第一款在新模式下生產的新能源車。問題是在最近這1年多的時間裡，中國汽車市場的競爭對手，投入的產品太多了。說實話，新車保鮮期大概就三個月而已。」
據《第一財經》15日（周日）報導，他進一步提到，在中國汽車市場快速變化的環境中，公司學習到了兩點：
第一，產品要經常有一些變動或新鮮感。不一定要大改、不一定要徹底大動作，而是要讓客戶感覺到變化。
第二，日產在中國已經有5款新能源車上市，每一款車都在進步，最新的是把過去一年半所學的東西全部集中在NX7這款新車上，且日產尤其想多接觸年輕人，讓他們變成下一代日產客戶。
根據日產2026年度上半年報告，與美國市場、日本市場內驅力仍是燃油車不同，日產在中國市場的銷量依賴於新能源轉型進度。
因此，日產對中國市場的新能源轉型尤為重視，近日，日產汽車以品牌進階為契機，推出三款新能源產品NX7、NV200 PHEV、27款鋒坦Frontier Pro PHEV，新能源產品矩陣進一步擴大至7款。
到2027年，日產累計將有10款新能源新車投入市場。
不僅如此，在大部分合資品牌執著於單一純電動路徑時，日產開始在一款新能源車上提供多種動力選擇。
馬智欣認為，很多中國消費者從油車轉向電動車的時候，會產生補能焦慮，進而選擇插混或增程。基於消費終端的需求，具體到產品上，東風日產以後每款產品都會是「純電+1」。
他進一步解釋：「這裡的『+1』是指插混或者增程，具體增加哪個版本由細分市場需求決定。目前，新亮相新車僅有一種動力總成，明年這些車都會再增加一種動力形式。」
paras_en: Nissan China Management Committee Chair and Dongfeng Motor Co. President Ma Zhixin said: "Nissan's complete new‑energy product matrix in China has gradually taken shape, including pure‑electric, extended‑range, plug‑in hybrid forms, as well as SUVs, sedans and pickup models. We hope that through our products, everyone can feel and recognize Nissan's renewal and change in China."

Ma admitted the company still faces overall sales pressure. "The N7 sold very well in the first few months after its launch last year; it was our first new‑energy vehicle produced under the new model. The problem is that over the past year or so, competitors in the Chinese auto market have introduced far too many products. Honestly, the freshness period of a new car is only about three months."
According to a report by Yidian Caijing on the 15th (Sunday), he further noted that in the rapidly changing Chinese auto market, the company has learned two points:
First, products need to have frequent changes or a sense of freshness. It doesn’t have to be a major redesign or a drastic move, just enough for customers to perceive change.

Second, Nissan already has five new‑energy models on the market in China, each improving, and the latest concentrates everything learned over the past year and a half into the new NX7. Nissan especially wants to engage more with young people and turn them into the next generation of Nissan customers.

According to Nissan’s 2026 first‑half report, unlike the US and Japanese markets where internal‑combustion vehicles still dominate, Nissan’s sales in China depend on the pace of its new‑energy transition.

Therefore, Nissan places great emphasis on the new‑energy transition in China. Recently, using a brand upgrade as a catalyst, Nissan launched three new‑energy products—NX7, NV200 PHEV, and the Frontier Pro PHEV (27‑unit lineup)—expanding its new‑energy matrix to seven models.
By 2027, Nissan plans to have a cumulative total of ten new‑energy models on the market.
Moreover, while most joint‑venture brands cling to a single pure‑electric path, Nissan is beginning to offer multiple power‑train options on a single new‑energy model.

Ma believes many Chinese consumers experience range‑anxiety when switching from gasoline to electric vehicles, leading them to choose plug‑in hybrids or extended‑range EVs. Based on end‑user demand, Dongfeng‑Nissan will make every future model a “pure‑electric +1”.

He added: “The ‘+1’ refers to a plug‑in hybrid or an extended‑range version, determined by segment demand. Currently the newly unveiled models have only one powertrain; next year each will add another powertrain option.”

items.title: 韓半導體大動作！SK海力士將五年內砸10.5億美元　扶持供應商+龍仁建測試廠
items.title_en: South Korea Semiconductor Giant Makes Big Move! SK Hynix to Spend $1.05 Billion Over Five Years to Support Suppliers and Build Trinity Fab Test Facility in Yongsan
paras: 面對AI晶片市場競爭加劇，南韓記憶體巨頭SK海力士週一(16日)宣布，未來五年將投入1.4兆韓元(約10.5億美元)，用於扶持南韓國內半導體材料、零組件及設備供應商，以強化供應鏈韌性。
SK海力士同步公布一項聯合出資計畫，將在首爾以南的龍仁半導體產業叢集內，興建投資額達8746億韓元的「Trinity Fab」測試設施。該設施由SK海力士出資4432億韓元，南韓中央與地方政府分別出資3736億及577億韓元，預計2027年5月營運。
供應商支援計畫涵蓋研發、測試、量產與銷售四階段，形成完整生態系，中小型供應商可在接近商業量產線的環境中測試產品，有效克服融資與技術障礙。
此舉正值SK集團全面轉向AI戰略的關鍵時刻。根據週日(15日)公開的研討會內容，SK集團會長崔泰源提出「AI飛輪」邏輯：以AI半導體競爭力拉動資料中心擴張，進而帶動能源與AI服務需求，最終反饋推動半導體技術迭代。
SK海力士作為集團AI布局的核心引擎，正將AI與數位孿生技術導入智能工廠升級，透過生產端AI改造提升效率，為後續產能調整與需求擴張奠定穩固基礎。
paras_en: Facing intensified competition in the AI chip market, South Korean memory giant SK Hynix announced on Monday (the 16th) that it will invest 1.4 trillion won (about $1.05 billion) over the next five years to support domestic semiconductor material, component and equipment suppliers, strengthening supply‑chain resilience.

SK Hynix also unveiled a joint‑funding plan to build a "Trinity Fab" testing facility within the Yongsan semiconductor cluster south of Seoul, with a total investment of 874.6 billion won. SK Hynix will contribute 443.2 billion won, while the central and local governments of South Korea will provide 373.6 billion won and 57.7 billion won respectively, and the plant is slated to begin operations in May 2027.

The supplier support program covers four stages—R&D, testing, mass production and sales—creating a complete ecosystem. Small and medium‑sized suppliers can test their products in an environment close to commercial production lines, effectively overcoming financing and technical barriers.

The move comes at a pivotal moment as the SK Group fully pivots to an AI strategy. In a seminar released on Sunday (the 15th), SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won outlined an "AI flywheel" logic: leveraging AI semiconductor competitiveness to drive data‑center expansion, which in turn fuels demand for energy and AI services, ultimately feeding back to accelerate semiconductor technology iteration.

As the core engine of the group’s AI rollout, SK Hynix is integrating AI and digital‑twin technologies into smart‑factory upgrades, using AI‑driven production transformations to boost efficiency and lay a solid foundation for future capacity adjustments and demand growth.

items.title: 輝達循環融資風險被高估？專家揭真相：多數是供應商採購款
items.title_en: Is Nvidia's Circular Financing Risk Overstated? Experts Reveal the Truth: Most Are Supplier Purchase Commitments
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 季度申報文件揭露高達5,305億美元的承諾與或有事項金額，遠高於資產負債表上的910億美元總負債，引發外界對其財務風險及人工智慧（AI）產業循環融資的疑慮。不過，會計專家指出，這些金額多數與循環融資無關，主要是未來支付給供應商的採購承諾，真正與AI建設及客戶融資相關的金額約為2,000億美元。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，市場近期關注輝達的財務承諾，包括揭露的3,660億美元承諾與或有事項、另有560億美元承諾，以及對OpenAI的1,085億美元承諾，合計達5,305億美元。
這個數字遠高於輝達資產負債表所列的910億美元總負債，但更重要的是，這些金額大多與循環融資無關。所謂循環融資，是指輝達提供資金給購買其硬體產品的客戶。
會計專家 Robert Willens 指出，這筆5,305億美元的承諾中，最大部分約2,790億美元，是對記憶體晶片製造商等供應商的未來付款承諾。這些款項將在多年期間陸續支付，並透過損益表反映。
博通(AVGO-US) 也公布類似的採購承諾，金額達1,270億美元，而其資產負債表上的總負債為880億美元。
輝達與博通的採購承諾持續增加，部分原因在於記憶體晶片成本高漲。
不過，分析指出，這兩家公司的相關數字都不至於令人過度擔憂，也沒有偏離合理範圍。輝達的晶片業務規模約為博通的5倍。
若聚焦AI基礎建設相關承諾，輝達的金額約為2,000億美元，其中對OpenAI的承諾就超過1,000億美元。雖然這仍是相當龐大的資金規模，循環融資也確實是值得留意的風險，但AI資料中心大型業者的支出規模以兆美元計，而非僅有數十億美元。
目前AI產業融資主要來自企業現金流、發行股票、債券及貸款。
外界對輝達是否透過放寬融資條件協助客戶購買晶片的質疑，仍有討論空間，但評估相關風險時，必須先釐清數字。輝達對客戶的融資承諾規模更接近2,000億美元，而非外界可能從5,305億美元總額所理解的規模。
目前，輝達未回應外界對其會計處理方式的置評請求。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) disclosed in its quarterly filing commitments and contingent liabilities amounting to a staggering $530.5 billion, far exceeding the $91 billion total debt shown on its balance sheet, sparking concerns about its financial risk and the AI industry’s circular financing. However, accounting experts say most of these amounts are unrelated to circular financing and are mainly future purchase commitments to suppliers, with the portion truly tied to AI build‑out and customer financing around $200 billion.

Baron Weekly reported that the market has recently focused on Nvidia’s financial commitments, including the disclosed $366 billion in commitments and contingencies, an additional $56 billion commitment, and a $108.5 billion commitment to OpenAI, totaling $530.5 billion.

That figure dwarfs the $91 billion total debt listed on Nvidia’s balance sheet, but more importantly, most of the amount has nothing to do with circular financing. Circular financing refers to Nvidia providing funds to customers who purchase its hardware products.

Accounting specialist Robert Willens noted that of the $530.5 billion commitment, the largest portion—about $279 billion—is a future payment obligation to suppliers such as memory‑chip manufacturers. These payments will be made over many years and will be reflected on the income statement.
Broadcom (AVGO-US) also announced similar purchase commitments, amounting to $127 billion, while its balance sheet shows total debt of $88 billion.
The growing purchase commitments of Nvidia and Broadcom are partly driven by the soaring cost of memory chips.
Nevertheless, analysts say the numbers for both companies are not cause for alarm and remain within a reasonable range. Nvidia’s chip business is roughly five times the size of Broadcom’s.

Focusing on AI‑infrastructure‑related commitments, Nvidia’s figure is about $200 billion, with the commitment to OpenAI alone exceeding $100 billion. While still a massive sum and circular financing is a risk to watch, large AI data‑center operators spend on the order of trillions of dollars, not merely tens of billions.
Current AI industry financing mainly comes from corporate cash flow, equity issuances, bonds and loans.

There is still debate about whether Nvidia eases financing terms to help customers buy chips, but when assessing the risk, the numbers must be clarified first. Nvidia’s financing commitments to customers are closer to $200 billion, not the $530.5 billion total that outsiders might assume.
Nvidia has not responded to requests for comment on its accounting treatment.

items.title: 車用晶片誰是老大？高通單季營收暴增89%直逼英飛凌霸主地位 僅差8000萬美元
items.title_en: Who Is the Leader in Automotive Chips? Qualcomm’s Quarterly Revenue Surges 89% Nearing Infineon’s Dominance, Just $80 Million Short
paras: 2026年第三季全球汽車晶片營收排名出爐，英飛凌(Infineon)以23.64億美居冠，恩智浦(NXP)20.70億美元、高通19.9億美元緊追在後，其中恩智浦與高通差距僅約8000萬美元，競爭趨於白熱化。
英飛凌汽車部門營收季增8%、年增9%，佔公司總收入約44%；部門利潤率從18.4%升至22.4%，改善來自銷量增加與產品組合優化，非單季出貨衝高所致。
恩智浦汽車收入佔集團比重高達55%，對車市依賴最深，今年第三季較一年前成長13%，庫存周轉天數從去年同期161天降至148天。
高通表現最為亮眼，汽車收入從去年同期10.53億美元暴增至19.90億美元，年增89%，主要受惠於數位座艙、輔助駕駛及連接平台需求。汽車業務佔QCT收入約22%，能否站穩20億美元關卡，取決於新車型實際裝車量與平台收益轉化。
瑞薩(Renesas)汽車收入12.02億美元，年增19.3%，部門利潤率32.9%，中國車企擴大採用28奈米MCU及日本客戶導入R-Car為主要動能。
安森美(onsemi)今年第三季汽車業務收入7.767億美元，微降1.3%，集團重心漸轉向AI資料中心。德州儀器、義法半導體及ADI本季未披露可直接併列的汽車晶片營收。
隨著各廠財報透明度提升，市場得以更即時掌握車用半導體實際態勢，後續記憶體晶片在汽車領域的漲價效應，亦將成為觀察重點。
paras_en: The Q3 2026 global automotive chip revenue rankings have been released, with Infineon topping the list at $2.364 billion, followed by NXP at $2.070 billion and Qualcomm close behind at $1.990 billion. The gap between NXP and Qualcomm is only about $80 million, making the competition increasingly fierce.

Infineon’s automotive division saw quarterly revenue rise 8% and year‑over‑year growth of 9%, accounting for roughly 44% of the company’s total sales. The division’s profit margin improved from 18.4% to 22.4%, driven by higher volumes and a better product mix rather than a one‑off shipment spike.

Automotive revenue makes up a hefty 55% of NXP’s group sales, reflecting its deep reliance on the car market. In Q3 this year, automotive sales grew 13% compared with a year earlier, and inventory turnover days fell from 161 to 148 days year‑over‑year.

Qualcomm delivered the most striking performance, with automotive revenue soaring from $1.053 billion a year ago to $1.990 billion, an 89% increase. The boost came mainly from demand for digital cockpits, advanced driver‑assist systems and connectivity platforms. Automotive business now represents about 22% of Qualcomm’s QCT revenue, and whether it can sustain the $2 billion threshold will depend on actual fit‑rates in new vehicle models and the conversion of platform earnings.

Renesas reported automotive revenue of $1.202 billion, up 19.3% year‑over‑year, with a division profit margin of 32.9%. Growth was driven by Chinese automakers expanding use of its 28‑nm MCUs and Japanese customers adopting its R‑Car platform.

Onsemi’s automotive business generated $776.7 million in Q3, a slight decline of 1.3%, as the group gradually shifts focus toward AI data‑center applications. Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics and Analog Devices did not disclose automotive‑chip revenue that could be directly compared this quarter.

As companies increase the transparency of their financial reports, the market can now track the real‑time state of automotive semiconductors more accurately. Going forward, the price‑increase impact of memory chips in the automotive sector will also become a key observation point.

items.title: 金融時報：黃仁勳考慮重返輝達 矽谷盟友正在組遊說團
items.title_en: Financial Times: Jensen Huang Mulls Returning to Nvidia as Silicon Valley Allies Form Lobbying Team
paras: 據英國《金融時報》15日（周日）報導，黃仁勳考慮重返輝達(NVDA-US) 擔任執行長，其矽谷盟友正向輝達董事會施壓，要求恢復黃仁勳職務。
多位知情人士透露，黃仁勳已與親信討論過重返輝達的可能性，儘管輝達董事會在展開獨立調查。一名黃仁勳盟友說，他們正組建一個由矽谷企業高層組成的「戰情室」，遊說推動黃仁勳復職，並計劃爭取白宮支持。
這名人士表示：「在科技行業，除了那些前沿AI實驗室之外，所有有影響力的人都喜歡黃仁勳。」他說道，黃仁勳本人支持這項行動。
不過，推動黃仁勳復職的行動可能會遭華盛頓關鍵政策制定者反對。美國財長貝森特15日呼籲黃仁勳離職後，輝達應進行一次高層重大改組。
同時，輝達董事會及臨時執行長科克瑞斯（Colette Kress）正全力在17日發布季度財報前穩住局勢。
即使是黃仁勳盟友也不確定應如何恢復他的聲譽，一名參與推動黃仁勳復職的人士承認：「與下屬發生婚外情足以被解僱。」
paras_en: According to the UK Financial Times on Sunday the 15th, Jensen Huang is considering returning to Nvidia (NVDA-US) as chief executive, with his Silicon Valley allies pressuring Nvidia's board to reinstate him.

Multiple insiders said Huang has discussed the possibility of returning with close confidants, even as Nvidia's board launches an independent investigation. One of Huang's allies said they are setting up a "war room" of senior Silicon Valley executives to lobby for his reinstatement and are planning to seek White House support.
The source added: "In the tech industry, aside from the cutting‑edge AI labs, everyone with influence likes Jensen Huang." He said Huang himself backs the effort.

However, the push to restore Huang could face opposition from key policymakers in Washington. U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen on the 15th called for a major senior‑level reshuffle at Nvidia after Huang’s departure.
At the same time, Nvidia's board and interim CEO Colette Kress are working hard to steady the company ahead of the quarterly earnings release on the 17th.
Even Huang’s allies are unsure how to restore his reputation; a participant in the reinstatement effort admitted: "Having an affair with a subordinate is enough to get you fired."

items.title: 貝森特要求輝達大改組！稱新執行長「應外聘」、10天內交代晶片違規交易疑雲
items.title_en: Bessent Demands Major Overhaul at Nvidia, Calls for Outside CEO and 10-Day Clarification on Alleged Chip Trade Violations
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）周日（15日）表示，輝達(NVDA-US) 在執行長黃仁勳遭撤換後，需要進行「大幅度改組」，並建議董事會從公司外部尋找新任領導人。他也要求輝達董事會及外部法律顧問在未來10天內，釐清公司是否明知存在違法晶片交易警訊，卻仍放任相關行為，以推升營收與獲利。
根據《彭博》報導，貝森特周日接受《福斯新聞》節目Sunday Morning Futures訪問時指出，鑑於輝達接連遭指控協助向中國實體銷售先進人工智慧（AI）晶片，他認為公司應從外部尋找新的領導人。
他說：「這讓我認為，董事會在尋找新任領導人時，應該從公司外部延攬人選。光是公司內部發生的這些事情，就足以說明他們需要進行大幅度的改組。」
貝森特進一步表示，他希望釐清輝達是否刻意忽視警訊，任由空殼公司將晶片轉運至中國。他認為，外界不應只關注黃仁勳個人的私生活問題，而應將焦點轉向輝達涉及的法律及國家安全疑慮。
他說：「我想持續追問的是，輝達內部究竟形成了什麼樣的企業文化？他們是否為了推升營收與獲利，而積極推動這些看似違法的銷售交易？」他並要求董事會及外部法律顧問在未來10天內給出答案。
黃仁勳與新加坡 Megaspeed International 前高階主管黃樂（Alice Huang）的婚外情曝光，加上美國懷疑黃樂涉及中國間諜活動，使輝達面臨全面檢視。
輝達董事會上周已任命財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）擔任臨時執行長，她也將於周二（17日）主持公司季度財報發布。
貝森特除了要求輝達更換高層，也持續施壓公司釐清內部合規監督問題。他向《福斯新聞》表示，輝達已聘請外部法律顧問，外界應能藉此獲得對公司「不遵守規範文化」的解釋。

貝森特點名商務部長盧特尼克 晶片出口管制遭質疑

貝森特先前曾表示，自己長期支持將 Megaspeed 列入貿易黑名單，但他周日特別點名商務部長盧特尼克（Howard Lutnick），指出相關決策權掌握在商務部手中。
他指出，其他多個政府部門都曾推動對 Megaspeed 採取行動，但最終負責主導決策的是商務部。
自黃仁勳上周四（12日）遭撤換以來，負責監督晶片出口及相關管制措施的盧特尼克，也面臨愈來愈多質疑。盧特尼克的發言人上周向《NBC》表示，他已同意赴國會作證。
民主黨議員也要求盧特尼克說明相關決策。美國眾議院民主黨議員海姆斯（Jim Himes）周日接受《CBS》訪問時表示，目前看來，盧特尼克似乎是美國政府內部阻止輝達晶片流向中國的主要阻力，外界需要知道原因。
海姆斯並指出，阻止這類情況發生，是商務部長及總統應負起的責任。
美國國會議員正加大對輝達及川普政府的施壓力道，要求雙方提供更多資訊，說明這家晶片製造商及美國政府是否已充分採取措施，防止中國取得AI晶片。
目前，國會跨黨派議員正支持一項出口管制法案，計畫進一步限制中國取得AI晶片及半導體製造設備，該法案最快可能在數周內獲得通過。
不過，貝森特周日反對將晶片技術出口限制納入法律的主張，包括民主黨議員提出的相關要求。民主黨預計明年1月起在國會取得多數席次。
貝森特表示，美國不需要額外立法，現有規範已經足夠，真正需要的是確實執行。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday the 15th that Nvidia (NVDA-US) must undergo a "significant restructuring" after CEO Jensen Huang’s removal and urged the board to seek a new leader from outside the company. He also demanded that Nvidia’s board and external legal counsel clarify within ten days whether the company knowingly ignored illegal chip‑trade warnings while allowing the activity to boost revenue and profit.

According to Bloomberg, Bessent told Fox News’ Sunday Morning Futures program that, given Nvidia’s repeated accusations of helping sell advanced AI chips to Chinese entities, the company should look outside for new leadership.
He said, "This leads me to believe that the board, when searching for a new leader, should recruit from outside the firm. The internal issues alone are enough to justify a major overhaul."

Bessent added that he wants to determine whether Nvidia deliberately ignored warnings and allowed shell companies to ship chips to China. He argued that the focus should shift from Jensen Huang’s personal matters to the legal and national‑security concerns surrounding Nvidia.

He said, "My ongoing question is what kind of corporate culture has developed inside Nvidia. Are they actively pushing seemingly illegal sales to boost revenue and profit?" He also asked the board and external counsel to provide answers within ten days.

Jensen Huang’s extramarital affair with former Megaspeed International senior executive Alice Huang, coupled with U.S. suspicions that Alice Huang is involved in Chinese espionage, has placed Nvidia under comprehensive scrutiny.
Last week the Nvidia board appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, and she will chair the company’s quarterly earnings release on Tuesday the 17th.

Beyond demanding top‑level changes, Bessent continues to pressure Nvidia to clarify its internal compliance oversight. He told Fox News that Nvidia has hired external legal counsel, which should allow outsiders to obtain an explanation of the company’s "non‑compliance culture."
Bessent singled out Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick over chip‑export controls, noting that the authority for related decisions rests with the Commerce Department.
He pointed out that several other government agencies have pushed for action against Megaspeed, but the ultimate decision‑making power lies with Commerce.

Since Jensen Huang’s removal on Thursday the 12th, Commerce Secretary Lutnick, who oversees chip export controls, has faced increasing scrutiny. Lutnick’s spokesperson told NBC last week that he has agreed to testify before Congress.

Democratic lawmakers have also demanded explanations from Lutnick. House Democrat Jim Himes told CBS on Sunday that Lutnick appears to be the main internal obstacle to preventing Nvidia chips from reaching China, and the public needs to know why.
Himes added that preventing such transfers is a responsibility that falls on the Commerce Secretary and the President.

Congressional members are intensifying pressure on both Nvidia and the Trump administration, demanding more information on whether the chip maker and the U.S. government have taken sufficient steps to stop China from acquiring AI chips.

Currently, bipartisan lawmakers are backing an export‑control bill that would further restrict China’s access to AI chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, a measure that could pass within weeks.

However, Bessent on Sunday opposed incorporating chip‑technology export restrictions into law, including the demands put forward by Democratic legislators. Democrats expect to gain a majority in Congress starting January next year.
Bessent said the United States does not need additional legislation; existing regulations are sufficient, and the real need is proper enforcement.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元創9月來最大單週漲幅 Fed升息幾成定局
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Posts Biggest Weekly Gain Since September as Fed Rate Hikes Near Certain
paras: 美元周五(13日)再創19個月新高，並寫下9月中旬以來最強單週表現。這波漲勢主要受到市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期大幅升高所帶動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.41，創2025年4月2日以來新高。本週已上漲1.1%。
美元這波漲勢始於上週五美國就業報告公布後。美國10月非農就業人數增加16.5萬人，遠高於市場預期的6.5萬人。此外，8月與9月的就業人數合計上修8.4萬人。
美元週一短暫喘息後，週二再度走高，主要因美國消費者物價指數(CPI)數據高於預期。10月整體CPI月增0.4%，低於9月的0.6%，但仍高於市場預期的0.3%。排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增率維持在0.3%，略高於市場預期的0.2%。
數據顯示，美國勞動市場表現強勁，通膨也持續居高不下。在此情況下，央行通常會採取緊縮貨幣政策。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)週二進一步釋出鷹派訊號，表示即使通膨數據低於預期，他仍支持升息，他並指出，若數據再度偏熱，政策利率甚至可能需要一次調升50個基點，高於一般升息幅度。
週五公布的最新生產者物價指數(PPI)報告，則稍稍緩解市場疑慮。10月整體PPI月增0.3%，明顯低於9月的1.4%，也低於市場預期的0.4%。年增率則為6.5%，略低於預期的6.6%。不過，這仍是2022年11月以來最大的12個月漲幅。
Fifth Third Wealth Advisors投資長Chris Osmond表示，「好消息是，生產者物價通膨已從9月高點降溫。壞消息是，降幅可能還不足以讓市場獲得期待中的利率緩解。生產者物價通膨年增率仍高達6.5%，今天公布的報告提高了限制性利率維持更長時間的風險，恐怕超出投資人原先預期。」
他補充，「或許比整體數字更重要的是，通膨壓力正從能源擴散到其他領域。10月能源價格實際下跌，但食品價格上漲1.3%，服務業價格連續第五個月上漲，運輸與倉儲成本也增加2.0%。這顯示通膨正逐漸滲透至整體經濟，而非僅集中在最初出現價格壓力的領域。若這種情況持續，Fed就更難將通膨視為暫時現象。」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員幾乎篤定Fed將在12月升息，問題在於升息幅度。市場預期升息25個基點的機率接近90%，升息幅度高達50個基點的機率則約為10%。
日元再度貶破160關卡
美元走強對日元造成壓力，日元兌美元匯率本週創下9月中旬以來最差單週表現。日元最新報159.76兌1美元，稍早盤中一度觸及160.19的低點。
這是日元連續第二個交易日貶破160關卡。週四日元才首次自9月2日以來跌破此水準。過去，160關卡曾多次觸發東京當局大規模干預匯市。
日本財務省週一表示，7月至9月期間，日本在外匯市場干預操作中共動用15.4兆日元（約963.8億美元），其中包括7月30日單日創紀錄的7.98兆日元，以及7月31日與華府採取史無前例聯合行動時投入的5.55兆日元。這是美日自1998年以來首次聯手買進日元。
日本財務省負責外匯事務的最高官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)警告市場應提防「單邊走勢」，並提醒交易員，「現在就忘記」美日聯合干預還言之過早。
美元走強也使歐元承壓。歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1.1022美元，本週創下10月初以來最差單週表現。
稍早公布的官方初值估計顯示，歐元區2026年第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)季增0.4%，低於第二季的0.6%，但符合市場預期。數據也更新了勞動市場狀況，歐元區第三季就業成長則呈現停滯。

paras_en: The dollar hit a 19‑month high on Friday (the 13th) and recorded its strongest weekly performance since mid‑September. This rally was driven mainly by a sharp rise in market expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.41, a peak not seen since April 2, 2025. It is up 1.1% for the week.

The dollar’s advance began after Friday’s U.S. jobs report. Non‑farm payrolls for October increased by 165,000, far above the 65,000 forecast, and the August‑September combined payroll figure was revised up by 84,000.

After a brief pause on Monday, the dollar moved higher again on Tuesday, largely because U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data came in hotter than expected. October’s overall CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, down from September’s 0.6% but still above the 0.3% market estimate. Core CPI, which strips out volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, slightly above the 0.2% forecast.

The data show a still‑robust labor market and persistently high inflation, conditions that typically prompt central banks to tighten policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled further hawkishness on Tuesday, saying that even if inflation data miss expectations he still backs a rate hike and noted that a repeat of hot data could warrant a 50‑basis‑point move, larger than the usual increment.

The latest producer price index (PPI) released on Friday eased some concerns. October’s overall PPI rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, well below September’s 1.4% and the 0.4% market forecast. The year‑over‑year rate was 6.5%, just under the 6.6% expected, but it remains the biggest 12‑month gain since November 2022.

Chris Osmond, Chief Investment Officer at Fifth Third Wealth Advisors, said, “The good news is that producer‑price inflation has cooled from its September peak. The bad news is that the decline may not be enough for the market to see the rate‑cut relief it hopes for. Producer‑price inflation is still at a 6.5% annual pace, and today’s report raises the risk that restrictive rates will have to stay in place longer than investors originally expected.”

He added, “Perhaps more important than the headline number is that inflation pressure is spreading from energy to other areas. Energy prices fell in October, but food rose 1.3%, services posted a fifth consecutive month of price gains, and transportation and warehousing costs rose 2.0%. This shows inflation is seeping into the broader economy rather than staying confined to the initial price‑pressure zones. If this continues, it will be harder for the Fed to treat inflation as a temporary phenomenon.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders are almost certain the Fed will raise rates in December, with the question being the size of the hike. The market assigns roughly a 90% probability to a 25‑basis‑point increase and about a 10% chance of a 50‑basis‑point move.
The yen slipped past the 160 per dollar barrier again.

A stronger dollar put pressure on the yen, which posted its worst weekly performance since mid‑September. The yen was last quoted at 159.76 per dollar, after briefly touching a low of 160.19 earlier in the session.
